heading.en: Darkness and apostasy will cover the earth in the last days—The Book of Mormon will come forth—Three witnesses will testify of the book—The learned man will say he cannot read the sealed book—The Lord will do a marvelous work and a wonder—Compare Isaiah 29. About 559–545 B.C.
heading.sm: O le a ufitia le lalolagi i le pogisa ma le liliuese i aso e gata ai—O le a oo mai le Tusi a Mamona—E toatolu molimau o le a molimau i le tusi—O le a fai mai le tagata ua aoaoina e lē mafai ona ia faitauina le tusi ua faamauina—O le a faia e le Alii se galuega ofoofogia ma le mea e ofo ai—Faatusatusa i le Isaia 29. E tusa o le 559–545 T.L.M.
